consequence.statement: Traefik will not start if the Nomad provider namespace option is configured.

original.statement: The Nomad provider `namespace` configuration option was removed in v3.0.0 and must be replaced with `namespaces`.

decision.reason: [ev-482dffeba461] says the Nomad provider `namespace` option is removed in v3, is now unsupported and "would prevent Traefik to start". That is an explicit failure, so a mandatory-work kind is justified. The upgraded Traefik cannot start while the removed option is set, so upgrade-blocked with critical severity fits. The proposed statement matches the evidence's own wording.
